coaching.summary: Take the bar from a rack onto the front of your shoulders with elbows pointing forward, squat until your hips sink below your knees, then stand back up.
cues: Keep the elbows high so the bar stays stacked on the shoulders.
Brace hard and sit straight down between the hips instead of folding forward.
Drive up with the chest tall and keep the rack position all the way through the rep.
